official.deadline_note: Applications for the Spring Release (Quarter 1 2027 commencement) open Friday 18 September 2026 and close 11.59pm AEDT Sunday 18 October 2026. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered in this round. The next release, the Autumn Release, opens sometime in March or April 2027.
official.status_note: The Spring Release for Quarter 1 2027 is currently open and closes on 18 October 2026; successful applicants must commence Monday 4 January 2027.
official.tuition_coverage_note: 'Tuition fees covered by the Australian Government Research Training Program (RTP).'
benefits: $38,707 (AUD) stipend per annum for three (3) years
Tuition fees covered by the Australian Government Research Training Program (RTP)
Paid employment permitted provided the work does not interfere with study
No requirement to undertake tutoring or other academic employment at Western Sydney University
eligibility: Be a new applicant applying to commence a doctoral program; or have commenced a doctoral program in 2026; or have received an offer to commence a doctoral program in Q1 2027
Be able to study a full-time PhD program commencing in Q1 2027
Be able to be onshore in Australia at the scholarship commencement date

International applicants must also have completed a Master of Philosophy (MPhil) or Master of Research (MRes) degree at Western Sydney University in 2025 or 2026, or be currently enrolled and under examination in one
Domestic applicants are Australian citizens, permanent residents and New Zealand citizens
Scholarships may be awarded for a Doctor of Philosophy (PhD), Professional Doctorate (DCA, DCR or EdD)
requirements: All applicants must complete and submit the Standardised Applicant CV as part of their scholarship application
Applications submitted without the Standardised Applicant CV will not be considered
Applicants will be required to complete an Expression of Interest (EOI) before being invited to submit a full application
The EOI on its own is not considered a full application and will not be assessed
All required documents must be provided before the closing date
documents: Standardised Applicant CV using the Candidate CV Template 2027 Q1
Research proposal and details of the proposed supervisor
Expression of interest submitted through the application portal
selection_criteria: Research scholarships are awarded on a competitive basis by a Western Sydney University appointed ranking panel
Ranking follows the Guidelines for Ranking Higher Degree Research Scholarships
coverage: Stipend of $38,707 (AUD) per annum for three (3) years
Tuition fees covered by the Australian Government Research Training Program (RTP)
application_method: Complete the Standardised Applicant CV to attach to your application
Submit an expression of interest (EOI) for the relevant doctoral degree via the application portal and select the Q1 2027 Scholarship Release
Your EOI will be reviewed by the relevant School/Institute and you will be invited to submit a full application
Existing Western Sydney University doctoral candidates who commenced in 2026 submit their CV via the scholarship form in WesternNow
official.application_route: Submit an expression of interest through the application portal selecting the Q1 2027 Scholarship Release, wait to be invited, then submit the full application with the Standardised Applicant CV.
official.study_mode: Full-time PhD program commencing in Q1 2027; part-time awards may be offered but are taxable
official.citizenship_residency: Domestic applicants are Australian citizens, permanent residents and New Zealand citizens; international applicants must have completed or be completing a WSU MPhil or MRes
official.international_eligibility: Yes, but narrowly - international applicants must have completed an MPhil or MRes at Western Sydney University in 2025 or 2026, or be currently enrolled and under examination in one
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Doctoral programs only - Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) or Professional Doctorate (DCA, DCR or EdD)
official.research_requirement: Applicants should work with their proposed supervisor when preparing the application, and the application requires details of the proposed supervisor
official.duration: Stipend for three years; tuition fees covered for the degree duration
official.description: Western Sydney University states it 'receives a high volume of applications and scholarships are awarded on a competitive basis', with Spring Release scholarships for Quarter 1 2027 commencement including a $38,707 (AUD) stipend per annum for three years and tuition fees covered by the Australian Government Research Training Program.
official.program_type: University research scholarship awarded through periodic releases

not_confirmed: english_requirement - the Spring Release page publishes no English language requirement
travel_coverage - the page explicitly excludes travel costs, visa costs, relocation expenses and other expenses
the exact rank order used by the appointed ranking panel, which sits in a separate guidelines document
verification.notes: The $38,707 stipend and three-year term, RTP tuition coverage, the explicit exclusions, eligibility including the MPhil/MRes condition for international applicants, the Expression of Interest then full application process, the Standardised Applicant CV requirement and the 18 October 2026 closing date were all read from Western Sydney University's own Spring Release page.

applicant_utility.summary: The Expression of Interest is not an application: WSU states plainly that the EOI on its own will not be assessed, so you must be invited to submit a full application and then actually complete it before 18 October 2026. The Standardised Applicant CV is a hard filter - applications submitted without it will not be considered, so download the Candidate CV Template 2027 Q1 and use that exact format. Budget for your own flights and visa, because the scholarship explicitly excludes travel costs, visa costs and relocation expenses.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Doctoral candidates already connected to Western Sydney University - especially international applicants who completed or are completing a WSU MPhil or MRes - who can start full-time and be onshore from January 2027.
application_readiness_checklist: Download the Candidate CV Template 2027 Q1 and build your Standardised Applicant CV in that format before submitting anything
Submit the EOI early enough to be invited and screened, leaving time to complete the full application before 18 October 2026
Lock in your proposed supervisor and research proposal, since you should work with them when preparing the application
Confirm you can be physically onshore in Australia on the scholarship commencement date and start Monday 4 January 2027
common_rejection_risks: Submitting a standard academic CV instead of the Standardised Applicant CV, which makes the application unassessable
Treating the EOI as the application and never completing the full application after being invited
Being offshore at the scholarship commencement date, which breaches a condition all recipients must meet
Applying as an international applicant without a completed or under-examination WSU MPhil or MRes
Assuming documents can follow after the closing date, when all required documents must be provided before it
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Flights, student visa costs, relocation and set-up costs, plus Sydney living costs beyond the $38,707 stipend - the scholarship explicitly excludes travel, visa and relocation expenses.
document_audit: Only one application can exist at a time in the portal, so pick your first-preference project and supervisor before starting
To pursue multiple opportunities, attach a cover letter ranking your preferences plus a letter of support from the Lead Researcher for each project scholarship
Honours and Masters students can apply but any offer will be conditional on their result
Existing 2026 doctoral candidates use a different route entirely - the scholarship form in WesternNow rather than the application portal
alerts: The release closes at 11.59pm AEDT on Sunday 18 October 2026, so do not leave the full application to the weekend
You must commit to a minimum of 35 hours per week of study throughout the year
You must remain onshore in Australia for the duration of the degree except for approved overseas study leave
Top-up scholarships are not available, so there is no supplementary funding route through WSU
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Submit an EOI through the portal selecting the Q1 2027 Scholarship Release, the School or Institute reviews and invites selected applicants, and those applicants submit a full application with the Standardised Applicant CV before the closing date.
